title: omp needs its own provider credential for the gateway (cloudflare-ai-gateway)
description:
The layer after cmb, found by a live run that got further than any before it (run_005301a2..., exit 1, 2284 bytes of harness output).

What now works: the container boots, clones, passes 3/3 environment checks, resolves the model from [orchestrator].model, and the pre-flight MODEL PROBE SUCCEEDS through the gateway. So gateway routing and Workers AI selection are both correct.

What fails: omp itself refuses to start.
  error: No API key found for cloudflare-ai-gateway.
  Use /login, set an API key environment variable, or create /root/.omp/agent/agent.db

cloud/sandbox/entrypoint.sh exports VENDOR-shaped variables — ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_BASE_URL/OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_BASE_URL, WORKERS_AI_BASE_URL — because that is how the claude and codex kinds consume a gateway. omp does not use those: it names the provider cloudflare-ai-gateway and wants that providers own credential.

Work:
1. Determine what omp actually reads for a cloudflare-ai-gateway provider — an env var, or a provider entry in its config/agent.db — and configure it from the entrypoint with the run gateway token. Read omps own docs or source rather than guessing; a wrong guess here produces exactly this failure again.
2. The probe must catch this class. It currently proves the GATEWAY answers, not that THE HARNESS can call it, so a probe-passes-then-harness-dies gap remains. Extend it to a harness-level check, or state in the report why that is not feasible.
3. Note for the kind table: this is per-kind knowledge. Whatever omp needs belongs beside the claude/codex gateway wiring, documented as such, so adding a fourth kind is a known edit rather than a rediscovery.

acceptance_criteria: A cloud run starts the omp harness and it makes a successful model call through the gateway, evidenced in the streamed harness output; a missing harness credential is caught by a pre-flight check rather than by the harness dying after start; the per-kind gateway credential wiring is documented.
